name: enable_all_object_control

stack.evidence: func_001D2600 does not access or change the Script value stack

notes: func_001D2600 selects the active scene-object registry, resolves each registered object ID, and queues operation type 13 for every resolvable object. Type 13 maps to the embedded CONTROL_ON name; its dispatcher clears the control-disable flag 0x100000000. This is the inverse of command 151 disable_all_object_control. The JP corpus contains 110 calls in 96 entries; 41 have an earlier command 151 in the same entry, and 78 immediately precede command 592.
